law_name: The Copyright Act of the Kingdom of Bhutan, 2001
term_of_protection: Author's life + 50 years (joint works from last surviving author; anonymous works 50 years from publication; ss. 18.1-18.4 per Commons summary)
orphan_works: No orphan-works provision found; anonymous or pseudonymous works: economic and moral rights last 50 years from first publication (s. 18(4)); author presumed from name shown (s. 20)
enforcement_body: Intellectual Property Division, Ministry of Economic Affairs, Thimphu (per WIPO registration replies)
notes: Berne in force 25 Nov 2004; WCT/WPPT status conflicting (2019 slides: ongoing; 2025 document: party), unconfirmed
